idea-plugin.name: Vibe Languages: TypeScript, PHP, CSS, ESLint
idea-plugin.description: First-class TypeScript and PHP support for VibeIDEA through the Language Server Protocol: vtsls (TypeScript, MIT), Phpactor (PHP, MIT), the VS Code CSS server and ESLint (both MIT, from vscode-langservers-extracted) wired into the bundled LSP4IJ client. HTML and JSON are left to the platform, which serves them natively. Syntax highlighting comes from the bundled TextMate grammars.
